name: Novelty Sample
description: Selects experimental conditions that are most dissimilar (novel) compared to a reference pool of existing conditions using distance metrics.

parameters.name: conditions
parameters.description: Pool of candidate experimental conditions to evaluate for dissimilarity.

parameters.name: reference_conditions
parameters.description: Reference pool of existing experimental conditions to compare against.

parameters.name: num_samples
parameters.description: Number of novel samples to select. If unspecified, all samples are returned ordered by novelty.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Distance metric for measuring dissimilarity between conditions.

parameters.name: integration
parameters.description: Method for integrating pairwise distances into overall dissimilarity scores.

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: DataFrame or array of candidate experimental conditions.

inputDataType.name: reference_conditions
inputDataType.description: DataFrame or array of reference experimental conditions.

outputDataType.name: conditions
outputDataType.description: DataFrame of selected novel experimental conditions.
